meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Personal tool pack: single-store memory injection (the store root holds machine-shared entries, machines/<machine>/ holds machine-private ones), see_image (vision model transcription via host LLM channel), dispatch_task/dispatch_challenge (workflow assemblers: task drafts the single plan-document form of the build task — plan skeleton plus a registration line — and emits paste-ready dispatch args, logging a start event on output; challenge drafts the independent falsification-gate / plan-challenge brief and, given adjudication fields, writes the findings verdict into a gate event; the safety form joins the brief only when named explicitly via forms; intent and decision list are back-filled from the ledger), dispatch_batch (batch ledger with start/gate/commit/review events; state is folded from the events and the ledger is an active-batches workbench whose rows are purged on the closing review), and usage_note (usage-log note hatch: the recorder listens on host tool-call events and appends this pack's five tools as a per-day, per-machine jsonl under the memory repo's memory/data/usage-log/ — successful calls keep only the argument key set and duration, failed calls keep the argument summary and error.info, and day files rotate on a 14-day window at write and registration time, synced in the same repo as the batch ledger; hidden snags that structured fields cannot hold get a note/tool/ok line, sharing one timeline with the call lines at retro time).
